variant.briefing:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at [Location] so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need a heavy-duty tractor beam to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at [Destination].

-Twitch
